trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
 g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
 pts={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==1}
 if not pts:return g
 r0=min(r for r,c in pts);r1=max(r for r,c in pts);c0=min(c for r,c in pts);c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
 sides=[(sum((r,c0) in pts for r in range(r0,r1+1)),(0,-1)),(sum((r,c1) in pts for r in range(r0,r1+1)),(0,1)),(sum((r0,c) in pts for c in range(c0,c1+1)),(-1,0)),(sum((r1,c) in pts for c in range(c0,c1+1)),(1,0))]
 dr,dc=min(sides,key=lambda x:x[0])[1]
 for _ in range(h+w):
  moving=set(pts); todo=list(pts);valid=True
  while todo and valid:
   r,c=todo.pop(); nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
   if not(0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w):valid=False;break
   if g[nr][nc] and (nr,nc) not in moving:
    if g[nr][nc]==9:valid=False;break
    moving.add((nr,nc));todo.append((nr,nc))
  if not valid:break
  vals=[(r+dr,c+dc,g[r][c]) for r,c in moving]
  for r,c in moving:g[r][c]=0
  for r,c,v in vals:g[r][c]=v
  pts={(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in pts}
 return g
